subject: HIPAA discovery: BAA availability & hosting boundaries (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@meditek.com>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@meditechlabs.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: HIPAA discovery: BAA availability & hosting boundaries (post-call recap)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary from our call:
- Meditek intends to route PHI-containing transcripts through the Redwood API for triage and clinical-summarization features.
- Primary concern: whether Redwood can sign a BAA and which hosting modes are eligible for PHI (Hosted, Dedicated, Private).
- Meditek security will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and to kick off the vendor security questionnaire.

Redwood answers (high-level):
- BAA: Redwood offers a standard BAA for customers handling PHI. We can send a draft for initial legal review — attached.
- Hosting modes: PHI is supported only on Dedicated (reserved GPU pools with customer isolation) and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. Our hosted shared tier is not eligible for PHI.
- SOC 2: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and arrange an evidence package for your security team.

Action items / next steps:
1) Meditek: confirm whether you want Redwood to send the BAA draft to your legal team (Samantha) and share the vendor questionnaire to start the intake.
2) Redwood (Aditya): start the vendor questionnaire runbook and compile SOC 2 artifacts; share a named point of contact for the intake.
3) Redwood (Marcus): propose configuration options for Dedicated vs Private (networking, key management, expected lead times).

I’ve attached a short SOC 2 summary and a BAA draft for your review. If that aligns, can we schedule a 30-minute follow-up next week to review the questionnaire and hosting decision? I’m available Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf, Redwood_BAA_draft-20261022.docx

From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@meditek.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@meditechlabs.io>, Vendor Security <security@meditek.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 18:24:00 +0000
Subject: Re: HIPAA discovery: BAA availability & hosting boundaries (post-call recap)

Thanks Chloe — very helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do want Redwood to sign a BAA; please send the editable draft to legal@meditek.com. I’ll loop our legal lead.
- For PHI processing, the Dedicated option is preferable for now because our infra team wants predictable isolation without managing an on-prem deployment.
- Can you confirm whether Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (we require customer CMK for encryption at rest)?
- Security would like the SOC 2 Type II full report or an auditor-approved bridge letter in addition to the summary. We’ll also start the vendor questionnaire once we receive a contact at Redwood Security.

Please copy me when you share the docs. We aim to complete the vendor intake by 11/05 to meet our Q4 rollout window.

Samantha Green
Head of Legal & Privacy | Meditek Health
samantha.green@meditek.com

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vendor Security <security@meditek.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 00:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: HIPAA discovery: BAA availability & hosting boundaries (post-call recap)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick reply and the timeline. A few concrete answers and asks from our side: 

1) BAA: Chloe will send the editable draft to legal@meditek.com by end of day. We’re happy to take markups and iterate.

2) Dedicated + KMS: Our Dedicated offering supports customer-managed KMS via integrations with AWS KMS and external HSMs in Private deployments. For Dedicated (Redwood-managed infra but isolated pool), we support bringing your AWS KMS keys (CMK) in most regions — I’ll validate the specific region and account configuration and confirm by Monday.

3) SOC 2 artifacts: I’ll coordinate with our security team to provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA/secure link or provide an auditor bridge letter if needed.

4) Vendor questionnaire intake: Marcus will be the Redwood intake lead. Marcus — can you own the questionnaire packet and share a single point-of-contact email for security@meditek to send the form to? Also state any preferred formats (Excel, SecureShare link, or DocuSign-based forms).

Proposed timeline:
- 10/23: Redwood sends BAA draft and named SOC 2 contact.
- 10/26–10/29: Redwood security runs the questionnaire (turnaround depends on depth).
- By 11/05: Target completion of intake and sign-off for Dedicated provisioning planning.

If that works, Chloe — please push calendar invite for a 30-min follow-up next Tue 10/27 10:00–10:30am PST.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 03:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: HIPAA discovery: BAA availability & hosting boundaries (post-call recap)

Thanks — I’ll own the vendor questionnaire intake. Practical notes for Meditek security team: 

- Intake contact: security-intake@redwood.ai (this mailbox is monitored by our security ops team). Please send the completed questionnaire in its native format (Excel or Word) and include a list of required evidence items.
- Preferred delivery: secure-share link (we can provision a temporary S3->pre-signed upload) or reports via an encrypted DocuSign packet. Avoid email attachments with full reports.
- For Dedicated configuration: we’ll need 2 weeks lead time after intake sign-off to provision an isolated GPU pool in your requested region, plus an additional 3–4 weeks if you opt for customer-managed KMS integration (depends on KMS access coordination).
- Evidence we typically provide up front: SOC 2 report (secure link), architecture diagram for Dedicated, network flow example, and our BAA draft.

I’ll send the intake mailbox and a short checklist to security@meditek.com right now and include a scheduler link for a technical onboarding session if you want to review Dedicated networking requirements before provisioning.

—Marcus
Security & Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
